verdict.rationale: Elastic documents OpenTelemetry ingestion for metrics, ships its own Elastic Distributions of OpenTelemetry (EDOT) for production collection, and says it is built on OTel from the ground up, which supports first-class OTel. However, the pack never explicitly describes a native OTLP endpoint that a developer can send telemetry to directly without an intermediary collector or agent. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a direct OTLP endpoint (protocol, auth, signals), confirmation that traces and logs as well as metrics can be ingested via OTLP, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send telemetry directly over OTLP with first-class OpenTelemetry support

citations.quote: Ingest metrics from any source using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus remote write, or Elastic Agent integrations.
Elastic Distributions of OpenTelemetry (EDOT) delivers production-ready collection with no vendor lock-in.
built on OpenTelemetry (OTel) from the ground up
